name: B3 matched-feedback reference and nested history residual (M0-M3)
context: All forecast roles were already inspected for the ridge models, so this is a post hoc reference comparison. Its only tuned quantities (the likelihood scale sigma and the ridge penalty) are chosen on validation by the fixed rules below.

B3 parameters are the original authors' 1000 posterior samples, fitted to sustained and 3/20 population means at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml; mixed and single 5-min conditions at 2.5 and 250 ng/ml entered their architecture selection. Single 10-min and 60-min pulses and the 0.25 and 25 ng/ml blocks were not used to fit these samples.
The posterior samples describe uncertainty about the population-mean model, not cell-to-cell heterogeneity; the feedback forecaster uses them as a fixed particle set.
No B3-based forecast had been scored on any data when this protocol was frozen.
prerequisite: results/b3/verification_results.json status passed (acceptance gate on the authors' sim_post exports).
data_roles: Identical to configs/fgf2_expanded_protocol.json (sha256 fe919ef8ee766522d62d2fff4d5c412771c41a2cfd7fb818f4800a698a873331), including its data rules and 10-min warmup.
simulation: Each condition's commanded schedule from calibrate_fgf2.segments, simulated for every posterior sample on a 1-min grid; f_s(t) is the noise-free FRET output of sample s.

forecasters.b3_open_loop: mean over samples of f_s(t+h); no reporter feedback.
forecasters.b3_anchored: y_t + mean over samples of [f_s(t+h) - f_s(t)].
forecasters.M2_b3_feedback: y_t + sum_s w_s [f_s(t+h) - f_s(t)], with w_s proportional to exp(-sum over observations t_i <= t of (y_i - f_s(t_i))^2 / (2 sigma^2)).
forecasters.M3_history_plus_b3: Ridge on the causal_history features of the expanded protocol plus the M2 increment sum_s w_s [f_s(t+h) - f_s(t)] as one extra feature; trained on the training role.
forecasters.M0_current_clock: current_response_clock refit under the expanded protocol (same rows).
forecasters.M1_causal_history: causal_history refit under the expanded protocol (same rows).

selection: Per horizon, sigma minimizing the condition-equal validation MSE of M2; M3 uses that sigma and the alpha minimizing its validation MSE; M0 and M1 select alpha exactly as in the expanded protocol.
metrics: Condition-equal RMSE per role and per-condition MSE on identical rows for every forecaster.

comparisons.C1_primary: 10-min test_new_protocol: M3 RMSE < M2 RMSE (history adds information beyond the matched-feedback mechanistic estimator).
comparisons.C3: 10-min test_new_protocol: M2 versus M1, reported without a pre-specified direction.

secondary: The same comparisons on test_new_protocol_inferred_timing, test_new_concentration_same_session, validation and viewed_reference, at both horizons, with per-condition direction counts.
inference: No significance tests or confidence intervals: conditions are not independent replicates and experimental-day identifiers are unavailable.
reporting: All comparisons are reported whatever their direction.
